subject: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Hi Olivia —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, attached is a draft Mutual Action Plan (Stellar-MAP-v1.2.pdf) and a short SOW sketch (Statement-of-Work-draft.docx) that map discovery -> eval -> production milestones and the suggested commercial triggers. High-level proposal:

- Evaluation window: 45 days (proof-of-concept with full observability)
- MAP milestones: kickoff, mid-eval checkpoint, acceptance sign-off, production cutover
- Pricing: list + ramp discount schedule tied to committed throughput in month 1–3
- Billing start: we usually invoice from either (A) the first production token consumption date or (B) a calendar date following SOW signature — happy to align to what works best for you
- Payment terms: standard Net30; we can discuss Net60 depending on PO/credit setup

Could you confirm Stellar Suite’s PO process and whether finance needs any vendor forms? I’ve looped in Dylan and Dev for technical acceptance criteria that will define the evaluation-to-production hand-off.

Attached: Stellar-MAP-v1.2.pdf, Statement-of-Work-draft.docx

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the MAP and SOW draft this week
2) Confirm PO / payment term expectations
3) We lock a kickoff date for next week if timelines align

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Marissa —

Thanks for sending these over. Initial read looks good; a couple of procurement asks from our side:

- Finance prefers Net60 on vendor invoices (Stellar policy)
- We need a formal PO in place before any invoices are paid; can you confirm Redwood accepts a PDF PO (we attach via Ariba) and provide remit/tax details?
- For this engagement we want billing to start after our production cutover (we define production as: first continuous 24-hour period of live requests), not at signature — can you accommodate that?

I’m attaching our vendor onboarding form and PO template (PO_Template.pdf) for your finance team. I’ll loop AP on the next reply.

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
Head of Platform Engineering | Stellar Suite
olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-18T13:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Hi all — quick technical clarification to make the MAP milestones unambiguous (so billing and acceptance lines up):

- "Mid-eval checkpoint": we’ll validate latency/throughput targets against the sample traffic you provide (we use the Sequences in the MAP)
- "Acceptance sign-off": a short QA checklist (attached below) that both teams sign — this is the point where we say the eval succeeded
- Production cutover definition: agree with Olivia — first 24-hour continuous live traffic window counts as cutover for your team

For pricing/ramp I recommend the following (examples):
- Month 0 (eval): no charge or a capped eval fee (you decide)
- Month 1–3 (ramp): 10% discount at X commit, 15% at Y commit — discounts applied to list pricing on monthly invoices
- Billing start: we can set invoices to start on production cutover date; alternatively if you prefer earlier we can start invoices on a date.

If Stellar needs Net60, that’s fine pending credit approval from our Finance team — Laura, can you advise on the Net60 cadence and any commercial approvals required?

Thanks,
Dylan
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stellar Suite Finance <ap@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Hi Olivia / AP team —

Thanks for the vendor materials (PO_Template.pdf). To make sure invoicing runs smoothly, we need the following on any PO:
- PO number and official billing contact
- Legal entity name and remit address (we’ll need this exactly as on the PO)
- Tax ID or VAT (if applicable)
- Billing frequency (monthly/quarterly) and preferred invoice recipient email

Our standard options:
- Net30 (standard)
- Net60 (available with a commercial approval and credit check — typically a 5–7 business day review)

Notes on billing start date: we can accept a formal calendar date (e.g., 2026-03-01) or an operational trigger (production cutover). For PO-based billing, we require a signed PO before the first invoice is generated. If you want invoices to reflect a later billing start date, please indicate that date on the PO.

We’ve reviewed the MAP and SOW draft; no blockers from legal/finance aside from the PO and credit check for Net60. If Net60 is required, please provide a PO and completed vendor form — I’ll kick off the credit approval.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Olivia —

Appreciate the clarity from finance. To accelerate the deal and avoid procurement delays, we can offer the following compromise:

- Payment terms: Net45 for the first three invoices (to allow Stellar’s AP cycle to absorb the change) subject to PO and vendor form completion; Net30 thereafter.
- Invoice cadence: monthly with line items per MAP milestone consumption; we’ll provide a monthly token/usage report with each invoice.
- Billing start: either (A) production cutover (first 24-hour live window) or (B) 30 days after SOW signature — we’ll honor whichever you indicate on the PO.
- Ramp discount: 10% for first 90 days if Stellar commits to an initial monthly throughput threshold (we’ve put thresholds in the attached MAP V1.2).

Attachments: updated Stellar-MAP-v1.2.pdf (maps the milestone -> invoice mapping), Statement-of-Work-draft.docx (SOW with billing language).

If that sounds acceptable, please return a signed PO (PDF) with the billing start option selected and vendor information filled in. Laura will proceed with Net60 credit review if you still prefer Net60 instead of the Net45 compromise.

Thanks — looking forward to kickoff next week.

Best,
Marissa

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@stellarsuite.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP & Evaluation Plan: onboarding timeline, billing start, and PO/payment cadence

Marissa / Laura —

Appreciate the flexibility. We will take the Net45 for the first three invoices as a pragmatic path to start (helps our internal cashflow). I’ve attached a signed PO (PO_4687_StellarSuite.pdf) using your remit details and indicated billing start = production cutover. AP will run the vendor credit form in parallel for Net60 options in the future but we don’t need that hold up now.

Next steps on our side:
- AP will release PO to you via Ariba by EOD Monday
- Platform team will schedule kickoff with Dylan and Dev for initial traffic templates
- Targeting week of 2026-02-23 for onboarding kickoff

I’ve attached the PO (PO_4687_StellarSuite.pdf) to this message.

Thanks — Olivia
